_comment: Manual corrections on top of CLDR territoryInfo (official + de_facto_official, national level only).

pseudoTerritories._comment: Natural Earth map features without a usable ISO numeric code (matched by NAME)

disputedAreas._comment: Every area of Natural Earth's breakaway/disputed layer (keyed by the rule's display name; areas = BRK_NAME). Where a UN resolution settles sovereignty, assignTo moves the area to that country; otherwise the administering country keeps it. dashed: outline the areas on the map (default true). countries: whose panel shows the note.

Crimea.note: Part of Ukraine under international law (UN General Assembly resolution 68/262); occupied by Russia since 2014.

Occupied regions.note: Parts of the Donetsk, Luhansk, Zaporizhzhia and Kherson regions are occupied by Russia; they are part of Ukraine under international law (UN General Assembly resolution ES-11/4). The front line is not drawn.

Golan Heights.note: Part of Syria under international law (UN Security Council resolution 497); occupied by Israel since 1967.

Western Sahara.note: A non-self-governing territory according to the UN, whose status is unresolved; most of it is administered by Morocco, which claims it.

Northern Cyprus.note: Part of Cyprus under international law (UN Security Council resolution 541); a breakaway state recognised only by Turkey.

Somaliland.note: Part of Somalia under international law; has governed itself since declaring independence in 1991.

Abkhazia.note: Part of Georgia under international law; a Russian-backed breakaway region.

South Ossetia.note: Part of Georgia under international law; a Russian-backed breakaway region.

Transnistria.note: Part of Moldova under international law; a breakaway region not recognised by any UN member state.

Artsakh._comment: Nagorno-Karabakh: under Azerbaijan's control since 2023, the breakaway republic dissolved in 2024

Kashmir.note: Disputed between India, Pakistan and China; shown as each administers it, along the Line of Control and the Line of Actual Control.

Siachen Glacier.note: Administered by India; claimed by Pakistan.

Arunachal Pradesh.note: Administered by India; claimed by China.

Junagadh and Manavadar.note: Administered by India; claimed by Pakistan.

Abyei.note: Claimed by both Sudan and South Sudan; a UN peacekeeping mission (UNISFA) has been there since 2011.

Ilemi Triangle.note: Administered by Kenya; claimed by South Sudan.

Southern Kuril Islands.note: Administered by Russia; claimed by Japan.

Lawa Headwaters.note: Administered by France (French Guiana); claimed by Suriname.

Courantyne Headwaters.note: Administered by Guyana; claimed by Suriname.

Sabah.note: Administered by Malaysia; claimed by the Philippines.

Kosovo.note: Declared independence from Serbia in 2008 and is recognised by about half of UN member states; Serbia regards it as its province (UN Security Council resolution 1244).

Taiwan.note: Governed by the Republic of China; claimed by the People's Republic of China.
